claims.sourceText: Programme development requirement package summary page, CIA-RDP96-00788R001700200002-1, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-cia-rdp96-00788r001700200002-1/cia-rdp96-00788r001700200002-1_djvu.txt
claims.text: The same package records the customer list for the work: 'From 1978 through 1983 intelligence collection [taskings were] completed for the U.S. Army, DIA, JCS, CIA, NSA, FBI, and the Secret Service', and states that 'INSCOM's efforts in the intelligence application of PE have been on an ad hoc basis since 1977.'

claims.text: A programme development requirement package short titled '902d MI Gp S&IA OPSEC Sppt CENTER LANC Init' proposed to 'Establish a new intelligence program utilizing psychoenergetics (parapsychology) to enhance existing intelligence collection and OPSEC programs, and an organizational infrastructure to manage administrative, training and operational functions for the program.'
